articles.title: Dairy farm near Moscow placed under quarantine following leptospirosis outbreak
articles.description: An outbreak of leptospirosis has been detected at a farm in the village of Staraya Ruza in the Moscow region. Restrictions have been imposed on the farm and surrounding area, including a ban on moving milk from sick animals off the premises and holding events involving livestock susceptible to the infection.

articles.title: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls and requires returnees from Congo to pay for quarantine
articles.description: Uganda is reinforcing existing border controls requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, the Health Ministry said Sunday, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola.

articles.title: Uganda tightens Ebola border controls as Congo returnees face 21-day quarantine
articles.description: Uganda is reinforcing existing border controls requiring citizens returning from Congo to undergo 21 days of quarantine at their own expense, the Health Ministry said Sunday, as investigators examine how a woman who traveled from Uganda to Nigeria contracted Ebola. All 60 contacts monitored in Uganda in connection with Kenya’s first patient completed their follow-up without developing symptoms, the ministry said. Uganda has reported no confirmed cases since declaring its earlier outbreak over in July.
